title: Introduce onboarding affinity signature and auto-generated release titles
author: Aisha Raman
release_notes: Adds a compact onboarding affinity signature and an opt-in release-title generator to synthesize concise changelog headlines from sampled compatibility and performance deltas. No public API changes; enables better changelog automation and improves onboarding validations.
description:
Motivation: Onboarding churn and noisy release notes make it hard for downstream teams to quickly understand model-level impact. This PR introduces two lightweight primitives: (1) an 'affinity signature' — a compact, deterministic fingerprint summarizing model deployment affinities (hardware class, quantization-friendly profile, typical seq-length distribution), and (2) an auto-title generator that synthesizes a short release headline from a small set of sampled deltas (perf, accuracy, compatibility) so release notes are actionable and scannable.

Design overview: The affinity signature is a small JSON-serializable vector (stored as a base64-encoded proto in manifests) derived from canonical probes: latency histogram buckets, memory footprint estimate, and a feature bitmask for common affordances (KV-cache behavior, streaming, structured-output support). The signature is intentionally compact (<= 256 bytes) and stable across semantically identical builds; it changes only when the onboarded model's serving-affinity materially changes. The auto-title generator is an opt-in pipeline stage in the onboard workflow that consumes the sampled delta report (perf regression/improvement percentages, compat findings like missing ops) and applies a rules-first summarizer with templated heuristics to produce titles such as "-3% latency (FP16 quant), compatibility unchanged" or "+12% throughput; ABI change: remap embeddings". Titles are seeded into the changelog draft to reduce manual edits.

What changed (high-level): added a new onboarding validator module (registry/onboard/affinity.py) that computes and verifies signatures; a release helper (registry/release/auto_title.py) that produces candidate headlines; CLI flags to opt-in to auto-title generation (cli/onboard.py); manifest schema bump (+manifest.affinity_signature field) and migration helpers (scripts/manifest_migrate.py); docs and a short RFC in docs/onboard/affinity.md; and a battery of unit + integration tests (tests/onboard/test_affinity.py, tests/release/test_auto_title.py).

Checklist implemented: [x] affinity signature algorithm (stable hashing + canonical probes) [x] schema + migration helper [x] auto-title generator with heuristics and safe-fallbacks [x] CLI opt-in flag and console note [x] unit + integration tests [x] basic benchmark to ensure signature compute adds <20ms per model sample [x] docs and changelog example [x] canary rollout plan.

Commits summary: 1) initial affinity probe harness and unit tests; 2) signature serializer and manifest schema patch; 3) auto-title generator and templating; 4) CLI integration and opt-in flag; 5) migration script and docs; 6) tests + CI fixes; 7) polish and fix reviewer feedback.

Files changed (high level): registry/onboard/affinity.py (new), registry/release/auto_title.py (new), registry/schema/manifest_v3.proto (schema bump), cli/onboard.py (flag), scripts/manifest_migrate.py (migration tool), docs/onboard/affinity.md, tests/onboard/test_affinity.py, tests/release/test_auto_title.py, examples/onboard/sample-manifest-with-affinity.json, .github/workflows/onboard.yml (expanded test matrix).

Testing and CI: Unit tests cover signature stability, serialization, and auto-title templating edge-cases. Integration tests run a lightweight onboard flow with synthetic model artifacts and assert that migration preserves previous manifests and that generated titles are parsable and under 140 characters. CI matrix includes python 3.10/3.11 and a fast path for the new micro-benchmark; all checks passed on the final run (lint, tests, type-check).

Performance: The affinity probe performs local micro-probes on a representative sample and is guarded by a 200ms budget in the default CLI path; typical compute on CI dogfood hardware is ~12ms per sample (median). We measured end-to-end onboard time delta +<2% when opt-in probes are enabled in parallel; signature compute is cached in the manifest to avoid repeated work.

Migration and rollout: The manifest schema is backward compatible; existing manifests without affinity_signature are accepted and remain valid. scripts/manifest_migrate.py will populate a best-effort signature when run as a one-off during a roll-forward for historical models. Rollout plan: opt-in for two weeks (internal) -> enable for all registry-onboard CI flows -> enable as default for new model uploads after one month, with a feature-flag guard.

Safety and security: The signature contains no sensitive customer data; it's derived from benchmark probes and model metadata only. All serialized signatures are checksummed and verified on read. No runtime behavior blocking is introduced; auto-title generator is non-destructive and produces suggestions only.

Related work and links: Linear ENG-1423 tracks follow-ups for richer affinity dimensions; related PRs implementing compact release drafts exist in release-assembler but are intentionally decoupled to keep this PR focused.

Notes for reviewers: focus on stability of the signature (edge-cases in canonical probe ordering), fallback behavior when probes timeout, and whether the auto-title template set is conservative enough to avoid misleading headlines. I included a small RFC in docs/onboard/affinity.md with examples and heuristics.

Merge: squash-merged after two approvals.
commit_messages: feat(onboard): add affinity probe harness and serializer
chore(schema): bump manifest to v3 with affinity_signature
feat(release): auto-title generator and templating heuristics
feat(cli): opt-in flag for affinity sampling
test: add unit + integration tests for affinity and titles
docs: add onboarding affinity RFC and examples
review_conversation: Benji Cole (reviewer): Overall looks good. Major request: make the probe ordering deterministic — use explicit sort on tag names before hashing.
Aisha Raman (author): Good catch — updated the probe harness to sort by probe id and added a test for deterministic ordering.
Marina Li (reviewer): Can we limit the title generator to a whitelist of delta types to avoid noisy headlines?
Aisha Raman (author): Added whitelist + safe fallback where generator returns 'see full changelog' if only low-confidence signals present.
Owen Park (reviewer): Migration script should be idempotent. Please add guard.
Aisha Raman (author): Added idempotency guard and added integration test for repeated runs.
